result.summary: The page is largely well-composed; the horizontally scrollable category chips and restaurant carousel (with the last card clipped at the right edge) and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected behaviors and not defects. One visual anomaly remains: the circular button in the top-right corner (next to the delivery address) renders as an empty gray circle containing only a small red dot, with no visible icon, making it look broken or unfinished.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header area appears as a plain light-gray circle with only a tiny red notification dot; its icon (e.g., bell, avatar, or notifications glyph) is missing or failed to render, so the control looks empty and broken.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon inside the circular button (e.g., notifications bell or profile avatar) and verify the icon asset/font loads; keep the red badge as an overlay on top of the visible icon.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the top-right circular button is the only indicator of pending notifications; as a color-only signal on an otherwise empty circle, it may be missed and conveys no meaning to screen reader or color-blind users.
issues.suggestion: Pair the badge with a numeric count or an accessible label (e.g., aria-label="Notifications, 1 new") so the state is communicated beyond a small colored dot.
